test_title: PYST 06: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 08 Oct, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4
solution:
The correct answer is '**have**' (option 2).

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The passage discusses the historical development and the current state of traditional medicines.
 
• The appropriate verb form should indicate an ongoing state or result of past actions.
 
• "**Have**" fits well as it describes the present perfect tense, indicating the action began in the past and continues to have relevance in the present.
 
• Other options ("**have being**," "**had**," and "**has**") do not fit correctly in the context of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

 

Complete Passage: *Traditional medicines (TMs) make (1) use of__ natural products and are of great importance. Such forms of medicine as traditional Chinese medicine (TCM), Ayurveda, Kampo, traditional Korean medicine (TKM), and Unani (2) __employ__ natural products and have been (3) __practiced__ all over the world for hundreds or even thousands of years, and they (4) __have__ blossomed into orderly-regulated systems of medicine. In their various forms, they may have certain defects, but they (5) __are__ still a valuable repository of human knowledge.* 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• **Have being**: "Have being" is not grammatically correct in this context.
 
• **Had**: "Had" is in the past perfect tense and does not fit the present relevance required here.
 
• **Has**: "Has" is singular and does not agree with the plural "they" in the sentence.
